title: Burrow
blurb: You're a great worm, and the camp on top wants what's buried. Steer with a held finger, the mouse or the keys, and swim down through the ground, swallowing gems laid out in rings and spirals, fossils and relics; sell your haul, buy the vibration to shake through harder rock, and dig past caves, lava and alien ruins to the core. Every seed is a new world.
